query:
UPDATE rb_game
        SET title = COALESCE($2, title),
            cover = CASE WHEN $3 THEN $4 ELSE cover END,
            is_listed = COALESCE($5, is_listed),
            is_active = COALESCE($6, is_active),
            settings = CASE WHEN $7 THEN $8 ELSE settings END
        WHERE id = $1
        RETURNING id;
